title: Open scalar and tensor square with geometric compositor
statement: For normalized scalar/tensor models and choices [def-sp-open-scalar-tensor-data], finite commutative rings A,B and map φ:A→B, any compactification X→Z→Y of f:X→Y and arbitrary unbounded inputs K,L, let openFactor and openScalar be the specified open factor maps [def-sf-concrete-projection-factors], and inputComparison the scalar tensor/pullback comparison [def-sf-concrete-projection-reduction-data]. Scalar(openFactor_A), followed by openScalar on K tensor Lf*L and open_B(inputComparison_f), equals inputComparison_g followed by tensor(openScalar K, identity) and openFactor_B at the scalar inputs. Both factors include the canonical geometric pullback compositor for the compactification. No separatedness of the schemes structure morphisms is assumed.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 07A6, 0D6D, 0E48; more-etale.tex Tags 0GL1 and 0GL6. Concrete proper/open argument of fix-prop-projection-formula, proof sentence 2.

proof.text: The open scalar map is determined by the open-adjunction unit equation. Apply the normalized open tensor square, then scalar/pullback geometric composition for the compactification. This includes exactly the compositor in openFactor and the tensor/pullback comparison in inputComparison.

proof_origin.place: Concrete finite coefficient-reduction square, proof sentence 2; the component argument recorded above.

lean.statement:
theorem open_scalar_tensor_square
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (c : Compactification f) (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A)
    (L : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A) :
    (scalar m φ c.Z).map (openFactor m A c K L).hom ≫
      (openScalar m φ c.i).app (input m A f K L) ≫
      (openImage B c.i).map (inputComparison m choices φ f K L).hom =
    (inputComparison m choices φ c.g ((openImage A c.i).obj K) L).hom ≫
      (tensor m B c.Z).map (Prod.mkHom ((openScalar m φ c.i).app K) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      (openFactor m B c ((scalar m φ X).obj K) ((scalar m φ Y).obj L)).hom
